If hiring is not done early enough, then revenue is left on the table when the mortgage lender cannot service the demand.
                - heading [level=3] [ref=f3e147]:
                  - strong [ref=f3e148]: The Solution
                - paragraph [ref=f3e149]: At Marr Labs we just announced the launch of Vox Mortgage, an AI voice agent designed specifically for the mortgage industry. The AI voice agent’s standout feature is its warm transfer capability, ensuring a smooth handoff from AI to live agents, increasing conversion rates and minimizing call abandonment.
                - paragraph [ref=f3e150]: "Vox Mortgage was created to address two crucial challenges in the mortgage industry: speed and seamless customer experience. "Dave Grannan","https://linkedin.com/in/grannan","Subject: Quick question about Marr Labs' AI voice agents

Hi Dave,

I've been following Marr Labs since your YC W24 launch, and your Vlingo-to-Marr journey stood out immediately -- going from powering the first Siri to now building AI voice agents that are indistinguishable from humans feels like the natural next chapter of that story. The $85B addressable market you're targeting in call-based work is a huge opportunity, and the Vox Mortgage launch is a smart wedge into a vertical with real urgency.

I'd love to learn more about how you're approaching latency and trust for phone-based AI agents at scale, and share a few thoughts on where we might be able to help each other.

Would you have 15 minutes in the next week or two for a quick call?

Best,
[Your Name]"
"Han Shu","https://linkedin.com/in/hanshu","Subject: Your work on ASR/NLU at Marr Labs

Hi Han,

Your background building speech recognition for the original Siri at Vlingo, and now leading ML/AI at Marr Labs after stints running ML at Airbnb and DoorDash, is a rare combination of deep technical depth and product instinct. I'm impressed by how Marr Labs is pushing AI voice agents to feel truly human, and I'd love to hear more about the technical challenges you're solving to get there.

I'm reaching out because I think there could be a valuable connection between what you're building and what we're working on.

Could we grab 15 minutes sometime this week or next for a quick call?

Best,

Would you be open to a 15-minute call in the next week or so?

Best,
[Your Name]"

I'd love to hear more about what you're seeing in the market and see if there's a way we could be useful to each other.

Best,

"Dave Grannan","https://linkedin.com/in/grannan","Subject: Quick question about Marr Labs' AI voice agents

Hi Dave,

I've been following Marr Labs since your YC W24 launch, and your Vlingo-to-Marr journey stood out immediately -- going from powering the first Siri to now building AI voice agents that are indistinguishable from humans feels like the natural next chapter of that story. The $85B addressable market you're targeting in call-based work is a huge opportunity, and the Vox Mortgage launch is a smart wedge into a vertical with real urgency.

I'd love to learn more about how you're approaching latency and trust for phone-based AI agents at scale, and share a few thoughts on where we might be able to help each other.

Would you have 15 minutes in the next week or two for a quick call?

Best,
[Your Name]"
"Han Shu","https://linkedin.com/in/hanshu","Subject: Your work on ASR/NLU at Marr Labs

Hi Han,

Your background building speech recognition for the original Siri at Vlingo, and now leading ML/AI at Marr Labs after stints running ML at Airbnb and DoorDash, is a rare combination of deep technical depth and product instinct. I'm impressed by how Marr Labs is pushing AI voice agents to feel truly human, and I'd love to hear more about the technical challenges you're solving to get there.

I'm reaching out because I think there could be a valuable connection between what you're building and what we're working on.

Could we grab 15 minutes sometime this week or next for a quick call?

Best,
[Your Name]"

Would you be open to a 15-minute call in the next week or so?

Best,
[Your Name]"

I'd love to hear more about what you're seeing in the market and see if there's a way we could be useful to each other.

Best,

I'd love to hear more about what you've learned building Crux and explore whether there's a way we could collaborate.

"Alex Liao","https://linkedin.com/in/alexliaoo","Subject: Dragoneye's zero-shot video detection

The Dragoneye Playground is a great piece of product work -- letting developers go from an uploaded video and a text description of categories to a working detection model in under 5 minutes is a huge unlock compared to the traditional annotate-and-train grind. I'd love to learn more about what you're building and see if there's an opportunity for us to work together.

"Dave Grannan","https://linkedin.com/in/grannan","Subject: Quick question about Marr Labs' AI voice agents

Hi Dave,

I've been following Marr Labs since your YC W24 launch, and your Vlingo-to-Marr journey stood out immediately -- going from powering the first Siri to now building AI voice agents that are indistinguishable from humans feels like the natural next chapter of that story. The $85B addressable market you're targeting in call-based work is a huge opportunity, and the Vox Mortgage launch is a smart wedge into a vertical with real urgency.

I'd love to learn more about how you're approaching latency and trust for phone-based AI agents at scale, and share a few thoughts on where we might be able to help each other.

Would you have 15 minutes in the next week or two for a quick call?

Best,
[Your Name]"
"Han Shu","https://linkedin.com/in/hanshu","Subject: Your work on ASR/NLU at Marr Labs

Hi Han,

Your background building speech recognition for the original Siri at Vlingo, and now leading ML/AI at Marr Labs after stints running ML at Airbnb and DoorDash, is a rare combination of deep technical depth and product instinct. I'm impressed by how Marr Labs is pushing AI voice agents to feel truly human, and I'd love to hear more about the technical challenges you're solving to get there.

I'm reaching out because I think there could be a valuable connection between what you're building and what we're working on.

Could we grab 15 minutes sometime this week or next for a quick call?

Best,
[Your Name]"

Hi Elle,

I came across RetailReady through YC's Winter 2024 batch and was struck by how directly you and Sarah are tackling retail compliance -- a problem that costs brands real money in chargebacks every day. Your path from BlackRock and Stord into building an AI-powered compliance engine gives you a great vantage point on where the pain really lives in the supply chain.

I'd love to learn more about how RetailReady's engine works and explore whether there's a way we could support what you're building.

Would you be open to a 15-minute call in the next week or so?

Best,
[Your Name]"
"Sarah Hamer","https://linkedin.com/in/sarah-hamer-881bb6126","Subject: Loved your story behind RetailReady

Hi Sarah,

I read about how your time at Stord surfaced the retail compliance problems that led you and Elle to start RetailReady, and it's a great example of founders building from firsthand pain rather than a hunch. Bringing an industrial engineering lens from Georgia Tech to an AI-powered compliance engine seems like exactly the right combination for this problem.

I'd love to hear more about what you're seeing in the market and see if there's a way we could be useful to each other.

Do you have 15 minutes for a quick call sometime this week or next?

Best,
[Your Name]"
